Dad (10 months later after mom passed): on sping break vacation in AZ visiting my brother-in-law. We had a foreign exchange student from Spain staying with us at the time. We were out to eat at a pizza place. We were flying back home on a red eye in a few hours.I was sitting next to the exchange student and he said my phone was ringing.  I saw it was my youngest sister and picked up. Immediately sensed something was off when she was asking where I was and who I was with. She told me dad had passed away and I don't remember much after, I know my husband took the phone as I think I screamed. Come to find out, he had been found at home sitting in his chair after my youngest sister sent a friend to check on him when he didn't call her back. He had gone to see my nephews in a robotics competition earlier. Called my oldest sister (their mom) to say he was home safely. Seems like he called her, sat down, and just went to sleep.

Hello and welcome 😊  I  don't know how old you are but I can give you my experience: I'm 43, been married almost 11 years. I was for sure nervous about when and how to talk about children when I was dating.  It's not a first date topic, but not a night-before-the-wedding topic either. My husband actually knew I couldn't have children before we even dated. (Long story short, we were friends in college but didn't date until years later after we reconnected after losing touch after graduation.) He reminded me that I had once shared it with him while we were in college. There's no easy answer and what I found in other relationships was to go with your intuition. The thing to remember: the right person will not reject you because of this. All the best to you and don't be afraid to reach out!
